headline: Apple's trade secrets lawsuit against OpenAI reassigned to new U.S. District Judge Edward Davila
summary: The high-profile legal battle between the tech giants sees a significant procedural change, with a new judge now overseeing the case.
details: Apple's trade secrets lawsuit against OpenAI has been reassigned to U.S. District Judge Edward Davila. This change replaces the magistrate judge who was initially assigned to preside over the case.
caption:

headline_marked: [[Geekbench 7 is out]] with overhauled performance tests for CPU, GPU, and AI workloads
headline: Geekbench 7 is out with overhauled performance tests for CPU, GPU, and AI workloads
summary: The new version introduces real-world CPU testing, new media workloads, and dedicated AI benchmarks to reflect modern device usage.
details: Geekbench 7 has officially launched, bringing the biggest overhaul to the benchmarking suite yet. It promises to deliver performance tests that more accurately reflect how users interact with their devices across everyday tasks, gaming, and AI workloads.
The update includes significant changes to CPU and GPU performance tests. Key additions feature real-world CPU testing, new media workloads, and specific AI benchmarks, alongside support for CUDA.

This new version aims to push computers and phones harder, providing more relevant and comprehensive benchmark scores. Users can now get a clearer picture of their device's capabilities in modern computing scenarios.
caption:
Geekbench 7 just dropped with its biggest overhaul ever! Get ready for benchmarks that truly reflect how you use your devices, from gaming to AI.

Geekbench 7 has officially launched, bringing the biggest overhaul to the benchmarking suite yet. It promises to deliver performance tests that more accurately reflect how users interact with their devices across everyday tasks, gaming, and AI workloads.

The update includes significant changes to CPU and GPU performance tests. Key additions feature real-world CPU testing, new media workloads, and specific AI benchmarks, alongside support for CUDA.

This new version aims to push computers and phones harder, providing more relevant and comprehensive benchmark scores. Users can now get a clearer picture of their device's capabilities in modern computing scenarios.

Source: 9to5Mac, Tom's Hardware, The Verge
